*Āsavaāsavasampayuttaduka, Hetuduka* (Patthana 18.19) is a canonical Abhidhamma text located in the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Tipiṭaka. As designated by its title, the text examines the combinatorial matrix between the *hetuduka* (root dyad) and the *āsava-āsavasampayuttaduka* (dyad concerning corruptions or cankers and phenomena associated with them), systematically detailing their conditional relations. It constitutes a specific analytical leaf section within the larger structural schema of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
